@@ -351,9 +351,10 @@ class URLExtractor
   def process_url(url_string)
     @stats[:urls_found] += 1
 
-    # Clean trailing punctuation from URL text (but not . or : which are part of URLs)
-    # Removes: ) ] } , ; ! ?
-    # Preserves: . (for .. in paths) and : (for scheme)
+    # Clean trailing punctuation from URL text
+    # Only remove obvious markup/sentence punctuation: ) ] } , ; ! ?
+    # Preserve: . (could be sentence-end or part of path/domain) and : (part of scheme)
+    # Conservative approach: only remove what's clearly not part of a URL
     url_string = url_string.sub(/[)\]},;!?]+\z/, '')
 
     parsed = canonical_form(url_string)
